Fig. 9 (A) Expression categorization frequencies for different avatar variants, asterisks indicate correct categorization significantly 585 above chance level (binomial tests, p < 0.05, FDR-corrected). The first four avatar types increase in realism: point-light 586 expressions, wireframe mesh, grayscale avatar and furless avatar. Additionally, a human avatar with monkey expressions was 587 tested; peak lip-smack, SBT and threat expressions (top to bottom) are depicted next to the confusion matrix. (B) Difference in 588 fraction of correct categorizations relative to the (now trained) naturalistic avatar for each expression category. Percentages at 589 the bottom indicate the overall difference in correct categorizations. (C) Expression categorization frequencies for the naturalistic 590 monkey avatar with time-scrambled frame order (binomial tests, p < 0.05, FDR-corrected). (D) Boxplots of pupil sizes during the 591 viewing of each expression category for all avatar variants. *p < 0.05, ***p < 0.001 (ANOVAs, post-hoc Tukey-Kramer tests).
